meta_description_en: Brief overview of Battle City, a Russian ZX Spectrum conversion where you defend your flag against attacking enemy tanks.

body_en:
**B_CIT — BATTLE CITY**

Yet another Russian game. This time you play as the defender of a symbol (flag), which you must protect from incoming enemy tanks. But beware: your own tank is by no means indestructible!

*(Original note: Again a Russian game. This time you must defend a sign (Flag!) to be captured or shot by other tanks. Beware of other tanks as your own is not indestructible!)*
body_ru:
**B_CIT — BATTLE CITY**

И снова игра от российских авторов. На этот раз вам предстоит защищать символ (флаг) от наступающих вражеских танков. Но будьте осторожны: ваш собственный танк отнюдь не неуязвим!

*(В оригинале также приведён английский текст: «Again a Russian game. This time you must defend a sign (Flag!) to be captured or shot by other tanks. Beware of other tanks as your own is not indestructible!»)*
